message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Finnish Youth Survey 1965","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8225","justification":"Nationwide Finnish youth survey mid‑1960s including leisure activities, hobbies and sports participation; directly relevant to leisure and sport in Finland in the 1960s."},{"title":"Finnish Youth Survey 1966","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8226","justification":"Follow‑up Finnish youth survey in the 1960s with questions on free time, leisure activities and sports; thematically matches leisure/sport in Finland during the decade."},{"title":"Finnish Youth Survey 1967","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8227","justification":"Part of the Finnish youth survey series; covers leisure time, cultural and recreational activities, and sport among Finnish youth in the late 1960s."},{"title":"Finnish Youth Survey 1968","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8228","justification":"Late‑1960s Finnish youth study including indicators on leisure, spare‑time activities and sports engagement; directly within the requested time and topic frame."},{"title":"Finnish Time Use Survey 1966 (historical time budget study)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8230","justification":"Time‑use survey from Finland in 1966 that records how people allocate time across work, leisure and other activities; useful for analyzing leisure patterns in the 1960s."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Leisure Time and Sports I (ISSP 1993) – Finnish Subsample (retrospective items)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA2150","justification":"Though fielded in 1993, includes retrospective questions on leisure and sport; the Finnish subsample can provide recalled information about leisure/sport patterns that may reference earlier decades including the 1960s."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Leisure Time and Sports II (ISSP 2007) – Finnish Subsample (retrospective items)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4850","justification":"Not set in the 1960s, but the Finnish data include retrospective questions on sports and leisure that can be used to reconstruct historical patterns, potentially covering the 1960s."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 4 (1975) – Leisure, Sport and Tourism (includes Finland)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0034","justification":"Earliest Eurobarometer with extensive questions on leisure, sport and tourism; fielded mid‑1970s but close to the 1960s and includes Finnish respondents, useful as early post‑1960s benchmark."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 32 (1989) – Leisure, Sport, and Tourism (includes Finland)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1840","justification":"Later cross‑national survey including Finland with modules on leisure, sport and tourism; useful for longer‑term comparison though not set in the 1960s itself."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 72.3 (2009) – Sport and Physical Activity (Finland included)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA4998","justification":"Provides detailed cross‑national evidence on sport and physical activity for Finland; while contemporary, it can be compared to older Finnish data (e.g., 1960s youth/time‑use studies) to study change over time from the 1960s onward."}]}
